risk_description: AI-generated synthesis may be separated from source evidence
Research repository may store sensitive transcripts beyond consent limits
AI synthesis may flatten minority or edge-case signals
Analytics may omit non-users and people who abandoned before tracking
Semantic search may retrieve outdated findings without recency flags
Design teams may accept fluent AI summaries as validated findings
Research evidence may be reused beyond participant expectations
Design decisions may not link back to evidence and review status
